error[ZBX-E1010]: the virtual machine's command service did not answer
  cause  nothing answered on vsock port 1025 of the guest
  fix    stop the machine; the next command starts a fresh one:   zbx vm stop
         read how far the guest got:                              tail -n 20 '/Users/ada/Library/Application Support/zbx/vm/console.log'
